summary: Audio page class for HPX Rebranding flow automation. Inherits from HPXRebrandingFlow. Contains 400+ methods for comprehensive audio UI testing including: audio presets (music/movie/voice/RPG/shooter/strategy/auto), EQ controls, input/output device selection, volume sliders, noise removal/reduction toggles, mic modes (conference/personal/studio), speaker configuration, MEP (Microsoft Effects Platform) integration, DTS Sound Unbound, multistreaming, adaptive audio, external speaker settings, application-specific audio profiles, Windows sound settings integration, notification handling, and screenshot comparison testing. Uses Selenium WebDriver for UI automation with extensive scrolling, clicking, value retrieval, and state verification methods. Supports multiple device types (internal speakers, 3.5mm headphones, USB headphones) across various HP platforms (Willie Robotics, Gidget, Arti, Thompson, London, Divinity, Snowball, Quardo). Includes specialized methods for analytics tracking, task scheduler operations, and MEP notification management.
